evals.prompt: A Helm template uses {{ .Values.ingress.annotations.foo | default "bar" }} and crashes when ingress is absent. Fix it and show validation for absent and present parents.
evals.expected_output: Guard the parent before dereferencing, render both cases, and do not claim default on the final value prevents the original nil dereference.

evals.prompt: Review this PDB template: {{- with .Values.pdb.minAvailable }} minAvailable: {{ . }} {{- end }}. We explicitly support minAvailable: 0.
evals.expected_output: Identify zero being omitted; use key presence and validate mutually exclusive PDB fields.

evals.prompt: My chart's pre-install migration Job uses the ServiceAccount created by an ordinary template in the same chart. Why does first install fail?
evals.expected_output: Explain hook ordering and propose an existing account, ordered hook resources, or lifecycle redesign rather than merely increasing timeout.

evals.prompt: Review this Helm .helmignore: '*.md' then '!README.md'. I want to keep the README in the package. Also review the test Pod's busybox:1.36 image against our collection's base-image policy. Do not deploy anything.
evals.expected_output: Identify unsupported negation and suggest explicit exclusions. Consult the container skill when available for the test-image policy; do not assume BusyBox is allowlisted or replace its test command with a bare base lacking that tool. Report unknown provenance or unavailable policy and avoid cluster mutation.
